title: Dealer interactions and dealership visits
summary: This topic centers on dealership interactions, with many fragments simply noting that customers brought the vehicle to a dealer and a smaller set expressing either strong praise or clear dissatisfaction with the dealer experience.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the dealer or dealership experience directly, including excellent service and appreciation for avoiding dealer visits for updates.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor dealer handling, including awful dealer experiences and dissatisfaction with how dealership actions were handled.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly procedural mentions of contacting or bringing the vehicle to the dealership, with some ambiguous negative wording that lacks enough context for a firmer label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are terse service-record style mentions of dealers rather than detailed customer evaluations.
The topic includes both actual sentiment about dealer quality and procedural references to dealership contact or vehicle drop-off, which limits thematic coherence.
Examples are insufficient to characterize specific dealership processes beyond general praise, complaints, and routine mentions.
